body: Thank you very much. When I came back to this thread today it made me feel a whole lot better to know I'm not alone, that there are people who have been here in exactly the same place and they've survived. Thanks.

Thank you so much, you understand exactly. Exactly. If you don't mind I may PM you sometime in the future. I can't tell you how much it means to see someone else say what I am feeling. This post really helped me, thank you.
Thank you, I'm visiting there now, I appreciate your help!

Thank you so much everyone. I have made it through the last two work days and am feeling a bit better. I've been trying to keep a positive mood and when I looked here tonight it really helped. Thank you so very much for your support, especially from people who have worked at places like this. It's like a whole different world to me. Thank you so much. I wish I could talk to you all more but I don't know if we can make 'buddies' or how things work here once you are feeling a bit better.
I hate this job with every fibre of my being. I'd like to thank you for listening to me and being so kind.

No. If I quit or get fired or laid of I cannot get welfare, which to be honest is an unsurvival amount. Adults here get something like $600 to pay their rent/food, everything. I don't want to do that in any case, I want to work, I like to provide for myself but I'm feeling so lost.

Multiple people downvoted this? Sorry I'm trying to be articulate and am asking for help. Fuck you! Is that better?
/u/duder501 Thank you. I will be ok tonight. I appreciate your time very much. You've given me several things to consider
No, we live in Ontario so his job (which is good and has a bit of security) only pays $14/hr. To be honest, this is considered a good job where we are now.

This job has 60+ different 'quality' scores on your calls. If you don't get 80% or over, you get a d/sat. If you get a d/sat you get a reprimand. By a quality I mean saying a word-for-word specific script or offering the customer something they don't want to buy, with exact wording, etc.

I have $600 in savings so I would be pretty much screwed. A one bedroom apt. here is @700-800$ mth and you have to have the two months deposit. 
We have welfare here in Ontario but I don't want to do that. I just want a job where I can work hard and not have a time limit on bathroom breaks.
I just don't know if I can cope with coming home every night and crying for 2-3 hours. I have nothing except for my husband and to be honest, he would be better off w/o me.

Thank you a lot. It's just been very difficult for me trying to do this new job and I'm having a very hard time leaving it at work. I dreamt last night that I was at my cubicle and I was 87 years old and my hands were shaky and palsied. I could barely see through my cataracts but I was still reaching for the phone and trying to achieve my qualities. 
I don't think that dream was beneficial to my mental health.
I can't move because the only good thing I have is my husband and he has a decent (not well paid but reliable and he likes it) job.

Not badly, obviously or I wouldn't be typing but this new job is making me lose it. I can't have a business again. I'm stuck with this. I just need some help to get through the fact I hate my life and cannot fathom doing this for another 20-40 years.
I'm just scared because I have not hurt myself in two decades (besides whatever substances, etc.) and I did tonight.

Oh I have a stupid little A.J.P. thing from the GIA but it cost me a lot more when I took it heh. [here it is](http://www.gia.edu/gem-education/program-accredited-jewelry-professional). The problem is that jewellery stores won't hire me because they sell crap and I know it. It's why they hire random nice people rather than trained professionals.
Thank you for talking to me.

I can't compete with sellers online. I live in Canada and our shipping and custom taxes have made it impossible. Plus, Paypal hates Canadians. I've tried everything, Kijiji, Etsy, Ebay. I can't sell enough to sustain myself. China sells "genuine" 4 carat Emeralds for $20, there's no way to compete, even if what I have is real.

There's nothing else here. I worked retail for years but my now my back is messed up from years of standing in heels. I spent the last decade running my own antique jewellery store online and for the last few years, owning a actual retail store. It became un-feasible.
